cards.name: Jump
cards.summary: Single jump with a speed-scaled launch and reduced forward speed
cards.behavior: Pressing jump on the ground starts a single jump. The launch sets vertical speed to 42 units per frame plus 0.25 times the current forward speed. Forward speed keeps 80 percent of its value. A dive or ground pound press cancels the jump in the air.

cards.name: Double jump
cards.summary: Second jump in a timed chain, with a higher launch and speed bonus
cards.behavior: Landing from a jump or freefall opens a short window for the second jump. The launch sets vertical speed to 52 units per frame plus 0.25 times the current forward speed. Forward speed keeps 80 percent of its value. A dive or ground pound press cancels the jump in the air.

cards.name: Triple jump
cards.summary: Third jump in the chain, available above a forward speed gate
cards.behavior: The third jump needs the previous double jump landing and forward speed above 20 units per frame. A wing cap replaces it with the flying triple jump. The launch sets vertical speed to 69 units per frame and keeps 80 percent of forward speed. A dive or ground pound press cancels the jump in the air.

cards.name: Long jump
cards.summary: Low fast jump from a crouch slide with a strong forward boost
cards.behavior: Pressing jump during the first 30 frames of a crouch slide with forward speed above 10 units per frame starts a long jump. The launch sets vertical speed to 30 units per frame. Forward speed multiplies by 1.5 and clamps to 48 units per frame. The slow animation variant applies at or below 16 units per frame.

cards.name: Backflip
cards.summary: Reverse somersault from a crouch with a backward launch
cards.behavior: Pressing jump while crouched starts a backflip. The launch sets vertical speed to 62 units per frame and sets forward speed to -16 units per frame, so Mario moves backward while he flips. The flip sound plays during the rise.

cards.name: Side flip
cards.summary: Quick flip from a turn with a fixed forward drift
cards.behavior: Pressing jump while turning around starts a side flip. The launch sets vertical speed to 62 units per frame and sets forward speed to 8 units per frame. Mario faces the intended direction and the flip sound plays during the rise.

cards.name: Wall kick
cards.summary: Kick off a wall after an air hit within a short input window
cards.behavior: After an air hit on a wall, pressing jump within 2 frames starts a wall kick. A later hit leaves a 5 frame window for the same input. The kick reverses facing and launches with 62 units per frame. Forward speed rises to at least 24 units per frame.

cards.name: Ground pound
cards.summary: Midair stall then a fast downward slam with a landing shake
cards.behavior: Pressing ground pound in the air starts a 10 frame windup. During the windup Mario rises by a shrinking offset that starts at 20 units and drops by 2 units per frame, only when 160 units of headroom exist. Then vertical speed sets to -50 units per frame and forward speed sets to zero. Landing triggers a camera shake.

cards.name: Dive
cards.summary: Forward dive that adds speed and caps the total
cards.behavior: Pressing dive in the air adds 15 units per frame to forward speed and caps the result at 48 units per frame. The dive turns a landing into a slide. A dive near an object can grab it. Wall contact after a dive causes a backward air knockback.

cards.name: Flutter kick
cards.summary: Hold jump underwater to kick toward a target swim speed
cards.behavior: A water jump sets vertical speed to 62 units per frame. Underwater, holding jump uses the flutter kick and moves forward speed toward 12 units per frame with 0.1 acceleration and 0.15 deceleration. The kick animation plays below 14 units per frame. Base swim strength is 160.

cards.name: Camera follow
cards.summary: Lakitu trails Mario with smoothed position and focus behind him
cards.behavior: The behind camera keeps a maximum distance of 800 units and a vertical focus offset of 125 units, with a 300 unit minimum distance. Lakitu approaches the goal state asymptotically. Horizontal focus speed targets 0.8 as a dimensionless interpolation factor, vertical focus speed and both position speeds target 0.3 as a dimensionless interpolation factor, and each target approaches at 0.05 per frame. The default Mario camera frames at the current zoom distance.
